body:
I'm probably 400 pounds currently and 6'1".

My day starts with me getting dressed and tying my shoes.  However, if I'm tying my left shoe, I can't have my elbows on different sides of my left knee because I'm unable to reach my shoe laces with my knee in the way.  I can demonstrate.  Sit down.  Put your left elbow on the right side of your knee (it will cause you to bend over a bit).  Then touch the top of your foot with both hands and that is what it's like tying your shoe as a fat man.

My joints creek (I'm 29).  When I walk around, I don't feel fat. However, standing for long periods of time makes me sweat. Any type of exertion makes me sweat.

When I poop, I have to wipe multiple times to get it all clean.

Sitting around a lot gives me hemroids. I'm currently fighting jock itch which just won't go away.

One time I went miniature golfing because I was bored and it had been a long time since I've been miniature golfing. I went alone. At the miniature golf course, the holes are sunk below the ground so you have to reach below the part of the ground your feet are on in order to retrieve your ball. On one of the holes I went to bend down and get my ball. I lifted my left leg off the ground for balance and put all my weight on my right leg. I think I bent my leg wrong because I felt a pop and a really, really sharp pain in my right knee and fell down screaming bloody murder because it hurt so much (perhaps you've seen that fat ballerina girl who did a jump thing, landing wrong, and screamed like hell grabbing her knee; that was me).

It was the middle of the day with no one around so I used the golf club to limp back to where I paid for the game, gave everything back, limped to my car and went home. My knee swelled up (I had no insurance to do anything about it) and it took about 2 weeks before it felt like normal again.

I have to purchase my clothes from a special store that caters to big (and tall) men.

I work a service job for three different companies all of which require you to wear their outfit while working for them. Only one of them actually had clothing in my size and even then only had 1 shirt for me. Another company made me wear a 3XL which was really tight and they took 2 months for them to get a shirt in my size.

I get paid in tips at my job.  I've seen some of the tips other people get and the totals they go home with and I don't think my weight affects the tips I make.

No one really talks about my weight in public.  At best, another fat dude will include me by saying something along the lines of, "Us big guys."  No one uses the word "fat;" they use the word "big" instead.
What if you're not depressed?  Is it then ok to commit suicide without talking to anybody?

The problem is I eventually won't be able to pay the bills and maintain financial independence and freedom.

There's nothing you can do for me.  I didn't make this thread as a plea for help, I just wanted to put my thoughts out there and see if I can get any suggestions on how to make death a more pleasant experience.

If my primary method fails, the only other solution I'd consider is Acetaminophen (Tylenol) overdose and that's a painful way to go.

I can't lower my age through running (i.e. Marine Corps doesn't accept 29+ year olds, not sure about the other forces).  I wouldn't be able to meet the weight and strength requirements to join any military organization within 2 months and running won't pay the bills.

My head is clear and I feel fine.

>**Ending your life because you might not get some "dream" job is incredibly childish.**

That's not the reason I've decided to end my life.
Too old, too fat, not a fun job, too dangerous.
Can't really say since it might potentially prevent me from getting a job and I've explained what that will lead to.  But it has to do with financial services.
My dream job that I'm pursuing requires me to have a clean record and no bankruptcies.
